title: John Oliver Mocks Operation Epic Fury: “Definitely the Stupidest Name I’ve Ever Heard”
summary: "It sounds like a VHS tape Hegseth put out of himself doing karate in a garage," the 'Last Week Tonight' host said. "It sounds like the name of an energy drink marketed to divorced monster-truck fans containing so much caffeine, it makes you shit your pants while having a heart attack."
tags: Last Week Tonight With John Oliver
